title.zh: 将伊莎贝拉Cauayan的Cauayan区医院床位由50张增至100张并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Cauayan District Hospital in Cauayan, Province of Isabela, From Fifty (50) to One Hundred (100) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of the Cauayan District Hospital in Cauayan, Province of Isabela, From Fifty (50) to One Hundred (100) Beds, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Huyện Cauayan tại Tỉnh Isabela từ 50 lên 100 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลอำเภอ Cauayan ในจังหวัด Isabela จาก 50 เป็น 100 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Distrik Cauayan di Provinsi Isabela dari 50 menjadi 100 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Daerah Cauayan di Wilayah Isabela daripada 50 kepada 100 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7213_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Cauayan District Hospital in Cauayan, Province of Isabela, is hereby increased from fifty (50) to one hundred (100) beds.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
